subject: Mutual availability + request to lock demo slot and introduce SSO/procurement owners
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Holt <alex.holt@acmeco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + mutual availability grid to pick demo slot

Alex — thanks again for the discovery this morning. Quick recap and a concrete next step so we can lock a technical deep dive: 

- What we heard: ACME wants predictable latency for document search, SSO/SAML support, and clear data isolation for pilot tenants.
- Goal for next meeting: 45–60 minute technical deep dive (demo + infra Q&A) with your platform/security owners.

Can you share a few windows that work next week? To make scheduling simple I attached two compact options (PDF) that map our engineer availability to your team. If you can also introduce the SSO owner and the procurement contact on this thread I’ll include them in the agenda and the checklist we’ll run through.

Attachments: redwood-demo-slot-options.pdf

Suggested agenda (flexible):
- 0–10m: short context & success criteria
- 10–35m: live demo focused on ACME flows
- 35–45m: SSO/SAML and deployment model Q&A
- 45–60m: procurement/next steps (if procurement on call)

Thanks — I’ll wait for your availability and introductions.

— Logan
Logan Wright | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0104
From: Alex Holt <alex.holt@acmeco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@acmeco.com>, Rahul Kumar <rahul.kumar@acmeco.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + mutual availability grid to pick demo slot

Thanks Logan — appreciated the clear recap.

We’re keen to move quickly. Our availability next week (Pacific):
- Tue 4/13: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 4/14: 09:30–11:00

Looping in Priya (procurement) and Rahul (platform/SSO owner). Priya — when possible, please confirm whether procurement needs a separate pairing call or if we can include a 10–15 minute call-in at the end of the demo for contracting questions. Rahul — please confirm whether you want an infra deep dive (longer) or the standard run-through plus SSO checklist.

I downloaded the slots PDF and marked a preference for Tue 4/13 15:00 PT.

— Alex
Alex Holt | Head of Platform Integrations | ACME Corporation
alex.holt@acmeco.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Holt <alex.holt@acmeco.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@acmeco.com>, Rahul Kumar <rahul.kumar@acmeco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + mutual availability grid to pick demo slot

Great — Tue 4/13 15:00 PT works for our engineers. I’ve tentatively booked a 60-minute slot on our side for 15:00–16:00 PT and will share the calendar invite once you confirm.

Marissa (Solutions Engineer) and Sean (Customer Success) — I’m looping you both in to own the demo and procurement/next-steps respectively. Marissa will run the demo; Sean will help scope the pilot SLOs and handle contracting follow-ups.

Rahul — if you prefer an extended infra deep dive, we can add 20 minutes and bring an infra engineer. Otherwise we’ll stick to the standard flow and use the attached SSO checklist to validate items during the call. I attached the checklist here as well (spreadsheet).

Proposed deliverables before the meeting:
- Redwood: short runbook + demo link, SSO checklist, quick cost estimate for pilot (attached).
- ACME: confirm participant roles for the call (platform, app owner, procurement), any IP/repo access we should know about, and whether procurement wants the 10–15 minute wrap or a separate meeting.

Attachments: acme-sso-checklist.xlsx

If everyone confirms, I’ll send the invite and a one-page agenda.

Thanks — Logan

Subject: Re: Quick recap + mutual availability grid to pick demo slot

Thanks — confirmed for Tue 4/13 15:00 PT. We prefer to keep procurement to the 10–15 minute wrap (no separate meeting needed for now).

A few quick asks for the agenda and paperwork so procurement can move quickly after the demo:
- Please include a brief note on data retention policy and the pilot scope in the one-pager agenda.
- Can your team share an example SOW template or standard pilot terms (even a draft) ahead of the call?

Rahul — I’ve added you as the SSO/platform point — anything we should flag beforehand (firewalls, IP allowlists, certs)?

Logan/Marissa/Sean — we’ll plan to have our app owner and one engineer on the call. See you Tuesday.

— Priya
Priya Nair | Senior Procurement Manager | ACME Corporation
procurement@acmeco.com
